summary.headline: Retrogradation and Epicycle Motion
summary.text: Explanation of retrogradation through the geometry and motion of epicycles, including the visible apogee and perigee, the equant and deferent centers, and the distinction between mean, fast, and slow motion. It contrasts the successive and contrary motions of wandering stars and the Moon in the upper and lower parts of an epicycle.
